news.title: Michigan fills free college gap, lowers eligibility to 21 — for now
news.summary_en: Officials are aiming to reach 8,000 residents with the Michigan Reconnect expansion and provide free tuition to young people whose high school education was impacted by the coronavirus pandemic.
news.author: Kim Kozlowski

news.title: Oakland County schools seek new tax to bypass funding limits. Some cry foul
news.summary_en: Should schools get more money? Voters in Oakland County are deciding whether it’s worth raising taxes to give local districts more money.
news.author: Isabel Lohman
